title: Docs and v1 acceptance round trip
lead: User docs and one end-to-end test that walks the acceptance round trip.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the dogfood run.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Milestone 5 and the acceptance criteria: all v1 commands work with no
third-party packages, and the round trip works.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: README or the project's docs location; one end-to-end test module.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
End to end in a temp dir: `ask` -> `inbox` shows it -> `decide` -> `context`
includes it -> `check` reports it decided; then `supersede` hides the old one
from `context` and `show` keeps it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Write the usage docs for every v1 command and add the round-trip test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes in an environment with no third-party
  packages.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
